name: clinc-saas
description: Medical clinic management SaaS platform — phase 1 foundation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @clinc/api" "npm run dev -w @clinc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clinc/api && npm run build -w @clinc/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
